messages:
deploybot: Tag created: v3.1.0-rc2 for repo/redwood-inference
deploybot: Commit: abcdef1 (merge/main -> release/v3.1.0-rc2)
deploybot: Changelog (high level):
  - runtime: memory leak fix for KV cache that affected long-lived chat sessions
  - optimize: new kernel selection fallback for Ampere+A100 mixes (reduces p99 by ~15%)
  - api: add per-route token-usage header for cost debugging
  - infra: rolling canary support and circuit-breaker for model-variant fallback

deploybot: Planned change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-02:30 UTC (30m)
deploybot: Rollout plan: canary 5% (15m) -> 25% (5m) -> 100% (10m) with automated health checks. Canary region: us-west-2.
deploybot: Backout tag: rollback to v3.0.9 if any regression; rollback command below.

maia: quick ask — can we pin dedicated pools for the canary to avoid noisy neighbors?
ben: noted the KV cache fix might affect live mem profiling. we'll enable extra metrics during canary.
jordan_sre: SRE will monitor p50/p95/p99, OOMs, and model-fallback rates. set alert thresholds to 5% increase over baseline.
mwilson: holding on DB migration — there's a lightweight schema tweak in this release. Can we gate that until after canary passes?
maia: agree with @mwilson. DB migration can be a separate short patch post-promote. avoids rollback complexity.

deploybot: Ack. DB migration flag is off by default in this tag. We'll gate via feature-flag: `release.db_migrations_enabled = false` for canary.
deploybot: Pin requests — please pin these envs for the duration: `staging`, `canary-prod-usw2`.

ben: one more — add the new `X-Route-Token-Usage` header to the canary so we can correlate cost spikes quickly.

jordan_sre: also request temporary bump of ingestion throttles in us-west-2 by +10% during the 30m window so retries don't cascade.

maia: Sample deploy commands for operators:
```bash
# create the release tag locally (already pushed by CI)
git checkout release/v3.1.0-rc2
# pin canary namespace
redwoodctl pin env canary-prod-usw2 --tag v3.1.0-rc2 --duration 00:40:00
# start canary rollout
redwoodctl rollout start --env canary-prod-usw2 --tag v3.1.0-rc2 --percent 5
```

maia: Rollback snippet if canary fails:
```bash
redwoodctl rollout rollback --env canary-prod-usw2 --to-tag v3.0.9 --reason "canary regression"
redwoodctl unpin env canary-prod-usw2
```

deploybot: CI status: build passed, integration tests passed (light), e2e scheduled. commit abcdef1 -> build/6789 passed.
ci-bot: pipeline #6789: ✅ build + unit + basic-integ (queued: e2e)

ben: I'll watch logs for KV pressure. tagging @jordan_sre for alerts.
jordan_sre: Got it. I'll be on call during window.

maia: Please add a short release-note snippet to the release page under "Runtime fixes" before promoting to 100%. I'll push a draft now.

mwilson: thx — leaving the DB migration off for canary. ping me when we schedule the migration window.

maia: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. starting canary ops checklist at 02:00 UTC.
